model.title: Advisory Committee on the Records of Congress Sunset Act

summary.text: The bill would eliminate an advisory committee that oversees congressional records 60 days after becoming law. It would require the Center for Legislative Archives to submit annual reports on how Congress's records are managed and preserved, and would mandate that the Archivist, Senate Secretary, and House Clerk meet regularly to review these record-keeping practices.
